title: Daily briefing: Reading for pleasure linked to big brain benefits
title_zh: 每日简报：娱乐阅读与大脑益处相关
abstract: Evidence that reading for fun is related to structural brain changes, improved mental health and reduced risk of cognitive decline. Plus, go prospecting for clean-burning hydrogen gas underground and discover the oldest galaxy ever seen.
abstract_zh: 研究表明，娱乐性阅读与大脑结构变化、心理健康改善以及认知衰退风险降低相关。此外，还建议在地下寻找清洁燃烧的氢气，并发现迄今为止最古老的星系。
